summary: Tested the two new Iron Rabbit features: (1) Community Admin Dashboard at /admin/community and (2) QR Scan-Back plumbing. Backend: all 18 pytest cases pass (admin verify auth flow, community tip submit/list/promote/reject/delete, public promoted feed, no-regression sanity). Frontend: AdminGate + CommunityDashboard fully functional — wrong token rejected with toast, correct token opens dashboard, tabs (Pending/Promoted/Rejected) with live counts, filter + refresh + sign-out all work, promote/reject/delete moderation actions all persist via API and reflect in UI + public /api/community/promoted endpoint. Settings modal 'Community Dashboard' row present (anchor with href=/admin/community target=_blank). QR scan-back E2E skipped (no camera in sandbox) — plumbing verified via code review: encodeTipPayload/decodeTipPayload roundtrip, BarcodeScannerModal calls onTipDetected, AppModals/PantryModal wire it to provider.stagePendingImport, QuickGuideModal renders preview with data-testid=quickguide-import-preview.

groups.moderation: 6/6 (promote no-token 401, promote 404, promote 200, reject clears promoted_at, delete no-token 401, delete 200 + repeat 404)
groups.public_promoted: 2/2 (public 200 no-token, promoted field-shape, no status leaked)

community_badge_in_quickguide.code_verification: QuickGuideModal renders data-testid=`quickguide-community-badge-${c.__id}` for each promoted tip whose resource_id matches the current guide
community_badge_in_quickguide.runtime_verification: not fully asserted — the auto-opened guide during test happened to be IRR-1200 (Settings) not IRR-1000 (Home) so no seed match; provider fetches /api/community/promoted on mount (verified via direct curl returns promoted tips)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 501-503: `else: query = {}` inside list_community_tips means an INVALID status_filter value (e.g. '?status_filter=garbage') silently returns ALL tips instead of a 400 error. Minor UX/API-strictness issue; consider validating status_filter and returning 400 for unknown values.

server.py line 502 comment claims legacy rows are treated as pending, but the else-branch resets `query = {}` (returns everything). If the intent was to include legacy null-status rows only under 'pending', the branch should be: `{'$or':[{'status':'pending'},{'status':{'$exists':False}}]}` — currently pending-tab returns ONLY docs where status='pending', so legacy rows without a status field are invisible from tabs but still counted (aggregate coerces null→'pending' via `key = row['_id'] or 'pending'`). Mismatch between counts and visible list for legacy rows.
CommunityDashboard.jsx hardDelete uses window.confirm() — works but breaks the app's dark aesthetic; consider a Radix AlertDialog for consistency (not blocking).

AdminGate stores the token in localStorage without expiry — safe enough for a solo-launch admin surface, but worth adding a short-lived server-side session token in a follow-up if this ever grows multi-user.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested surfaces (admin dashboard + settings row); QR scan-back not runnable

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed community tips during testing; cleaned up via DELETE /api/community/tips/{id}. Verified 0 TEST_ tips remain (only 1 legacy non-TEST tip left in db, unrelated).
